name: – Nacho Sánchez Amor – After § 15 – Am 2
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Türkiye
part_text: 15a. Strongly condemns the recent arrest and detention of the Swedish journalist Joakim Medin; reiterates that freedom of the press is a fundamental right and core EU value; strongly condemns the accusations made against Joakim Medin, which are solely based on his journalistic work and therefore demands his immediate and unconditional release and that of other journalists imprisoned for exercising their freedom of speech;
